note: DISCOVERY ON THE OLDER HALF ONLY: every case, look-alike and population row has its whole label window before 2024-01-01. Nothing here is a verdict. Lift = how much more often the decile holds a winner than the matched sample overall; popWin / popLose / popFwd = whole-market winner rate, loser rate and average forward return (entry open to the window's last close, capped at +300%) of liquid stock-days in that decile.

describe.hi52: distance from the highest close of the last 252 sessions (0 = at the high)
describe.dry: quietest 5-day average volume of the last 15 sessions / the 50-day average (low = volume dried up)
describe.dryPop: today's volume ratio / the dry-up ratio (expansion after a dry-up)
describe.vcp: average true range 10 days / 50 days (low = volatility contracted)
describe.gapUp20: number of 3%+ opening gaps up, last 20 sessions
describe.ovn20: overnight (close-to-open) part of the last 20 sessions' move (log)
describe.intra20: intraday (open-to-close) part of the last 20 sessions' move (log)
describe.clv: where the close sits in today's range (1 = at the high)
describe.udVol20: volume on up days / volume on down days, 20 sessions
describe.baseLen: sessions the stock has stayed inside a 30% range before today (prior base length)
describe.rsSec: 3-month return minus the sector median (SIC 2-digit, 5+ liquid peers)
describe.breadthSec: share of liquid sector peers beating SPY over 20 sessions
describe.dShares: share-count change over a year (known 30 days late; + = dilution)
describe.logMcap: log10 market value (close x shares known 30 days late)
describe.earnDays: calendar days since the last earnings report (Nasdaq calendar)
